skill.summary: Manage Apple Notes via the memo CLI on macOS (create, view, edit, delete, search, move, export). And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of apple-notes skill (version 1.0.0)
- Manage Apple Notes with the memo CLI on macOS: create, view, edit, delete, search, move, and export notes
- Access over 50 AI models for image and video generation, chat, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, web search, document processing, email, and SMS via unified API
- Requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY for authentication
